name: The Italian Campaign
notes: Includes Operation Compass. 60.23 in the scan points to Case 60.72 for victory conditions; they are printed at 60.82.

A place scores for the side holding it with a combat unit (non-parenthesised Close Assault rating) that can trace supply of at most one Game-Turn to a dump or city whose line leads back to Cairo (CW) or Tripoli (Italian). Under abstract supply: R-110's route to Nofilia (Italian) or Cairo (Commonwealth) (points_supply, R-186).

If at the end no Italian combat unit on the map can trace a supply line, the Commonwealth wins a strategic victory (cut_off: R-110's route to Nofilia, the map end of the off-map line to Tripoli; R-185); otherwise most points wins the printed plain 'Victory', recorded as tactical, and equal totals are a draw.
